ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 white-to-black pixel ratio; high-intensity white dominates the central and distal lobe regions, while low-intensity black is concentrated along the trailing edges and the upper-central insertion area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white areas across both lobes. Dense dark stippling/mottling is clustered in the upper-central region (peduncle area). Right lobe contains a cluster of 5-7 discrete dark focal spots in the lower-middle quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A sharp, symmetric V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 80 degrees; the notch depth is roughly 1/6th of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude variations are most pronounced at the distal tips, showing jagged peaks of 5-10 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curve along the trailing edge leading to pointed, slightly upturned tips; the trailing edge forms a wide 'S' curve from the notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity white circular pixel groups detected on the far-left distal tip and in a scattered pattern across the lower-half of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent diagonal high-intensity white linear marks (scratches) on the inner right lobe; multiple shorter, horizontal linear disruptions are visible across the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive diagonal rake marks (three parallel lines) on the right lobe; several high-contrast white pit scars on the central-right fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense, high-contrast dark pixel 'cloud' or stippling zone localized specifically to the upper-left interior section adjacent to the notch.
